environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on EC2 instance behind a standard Application Load Balancer with no WAF association. The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic directly to the application on port 3000. The application runs as the 'app' user with write access to /var/app/data/ and read access to /etc/, /var/, and other system directories. No filesystem-level restrictions (AppArmor/SELinux disabled). The instance uses Amazon Linux 2023 with default security group allowing inbound 443.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, no WAF association
config.filesystem: ext4, no mount restrictions, AppArmor disabled
config.network: VPC with public subnet, SG allows 443 inbound
